m2-methods.note: The giving page reads the active payment methods from the real backend and shows the recipient details — 2 methods offered

m2-report.note: A guest reports a gift to the general fund: 201, a reference and a tracking code shown once; nothing public changes — public received total unchanged; the code is in no address or storage

m2-evidence.note: The receipt accepts one screenshot: 204, and the page says it is attached

m2-status-reported.note: The tracking code shows the gift waiting, with no personal detail; a wrong code is refused alike

m2-queue.note: The super administrator reaches the queue from the account page and sees the reported gift with its screenshot flag

m2-detail.note: The gift page shows what was reported, the private payer name, and the screenshot from the authenticated route — picture decoded in the page; served no-store

m2-confirm.note: Confirming with a typed case and amount: one POST, the gift is confirmed, and the public total rises by exactly that amount at that moment — received +$40; the fund shows it

m2-status-confirmed.note: The donor's status page now says verified, with the amount

m2-refund.note: A partial refund with its required note: the net amount and the public total fall by it; an amount above what stands is refused and changes nothing — net $25 after a $15 refund; a $30 reversal refused (409)

m2-reject-reopen.note: A second report is rejected (the donor sees the reason), then reopened; neither touches a public total

m2-manual-entry.note: Manual entry records a gift confirmed at once and the public total rises by it

m2-donor-cannot-review.note: An anonymous browser is sent to sign-in from the review pages, and the API answers 401 without saying whether a gift exists

m2-clean.note: No content-policy violation or page error in either browser during the run

m2-present-give.note: Report form in English and French, light and dark, 360 and 1440 px: language, theme, no overflow, no clipped control, contrast, no untranslated text, no policy violation — 8 combinations, lowest contrast 5

m2-keyboard-give.note: Report form with the keyboard alone: Tab reaches every control in order with a visible focus — 11 controls

m2-present-track.note: Status page in the eight combinations — lowest contrast 5

m2-lost-answer.note: The answer to a report is lost: the page says so and resends nothing; the person submits again and gets the receipt of the one gift that exists — first POST processed (201) and lost; the same key and body returned the receipt; one row

m2-stale-token.note: A report sent with another session's token: 403 csrf_invalid, a message, one request, nothing recorded; the entries are kept and a second submit succeeds

m2-double-submit.note: Pressing the button twice sends one report

m2-card-number.note: A card-shaped value in a text field: refused, the field is named with the reason, nothing stored

m2-french-phone.note: In French at 390 px: the form, the receipt and the status are in French with no sideways scroll

m2-donor-account.note: A signed-in donor account at the review pages: told it cannot review; the API answers 403 forbidden

m2-admin-french-phone.note: Review queue and a gift page in French at 390 px: translated, no sideways scroll

m2-provider-reference.note: One payment is counted once: a report confirmed with a provider reference, then a manual entry with the same reference and method is refused and nothing is added — method zelle; 409 duplicate_payment_reference

m2-admin-session-lost.note: The staff session ends while a confirmation is being typed: the POST is refused 403, is not sent again, the sign-in screen follows, and the gift is still waiting

m2-clean-2.note: No content-policy violation or page error in any browser during this part
